_comment: Mode-to-visual configuration. Canonical source: vault/Reference — Mode-to-Visual Configuration.md. Keep in sync manually until generation is automated.

process-mapping.notes: Added 2026-06-13: live mode for the flowchart / sequence-diagram / state-diagram tools. The analyst draws the diagram in Mermaid; the visual hook recovers it (dialect picks the exact kind) or synthesizes the threaded kind. Multi-kind: the technique's target kind is threaded so the right one is produced.

information-density.notes: Added 2026-06-13: live mode for the comparison / time-series / distribution / scatter / heatmap chart tools. Multi-kind QUANT family — the technique's target chart kind is threaded so synthesis builds that chart rather than visual_types[0].

spatial-reasoning.notes: Annotations overlaid on user's original input; preserves spatial arrangement.

systems-dynamics-causal.notes: Added 2026-06-13: causal-loop side of the split legacy systems-dynamics mode. Restores the visual-synthesis gate for the causal-loop-diagram tool.

systems-dynamics-structural.notes: Added 2026-06-13: structural/stock-and-flow side of the split legacy systems-dynamics mode.

causal-dag.notes: Added 2026-06-13: live mode for the causal-dag tool (lineage: relationship-mapping / consequences-and-sequel).

decision-architecture.notes: Added 2026-06-13: live mode for the influence-diagram tool (lineage: decision-under-uncertainty / strategic-interaction).

fragility-antifragility-audit.notes: Added 2026-06-13: live mode for the bow-tie-diagram tool.

strategic-interaction.notes: Decision tree here is a game tree.

root-cause-analysis.notes: CLD only when loops are present in the causal chain.

benefits-analysis.notes: Tornado for quantified benefit claims; pro_con for qualitative PMI assembly.

synthesis.notes: Concept map captures structural parallels between frameworks.

passion-exploration.notes: Visual is for navigation, not argument. Annotate-only adversarial.

cui-bono.notes: Flowchart for interest-flow tracing; concept map for institutional structure.

steelman-construction.notes: Constrained single-sided concept map: reconstructed claim, supporting premises, and premise interactions.

deep-clarification.notes: Flowchart when the mechanism is procedural; concept-map fallback for grounded relationships.

paradigm-suspension.notes: A constrained concept map keeps assumptions and alternatives provisional instead of collapsing them into a hierarchy.

project-mode.notes: Project Mode uses the universal source-grounded concept-map fallback; an explicitly requested visual type still takes precedence.

structured-output.notes: Pass through source envelopes byte-equivalent; a new concept map is allowed only for relationship-bearing source content not already represented.

red-team-assessment.notes: Ranks vulnerabilities by severity. Use annotate for a supplied diagram; otherwise emit a grounded concept map, causal loop, or flowchart matching the relationship structure. Severity uses colour plus prefix labels for accessibility. canvas_action is annotate when a source diagram exists, never replace.

red-team-advocate.notes: Ranks attacks by persuasive force for a named external audience. Use annotate for a supplied diagram; otherwise emit a grounded concept map, causal loop, or flowchart matching the relationship structure. canvas_action is annotate when a source diagram exists, never replace.

argument-audit.notes: Map inferential moves and their supporting premises.

balanced-critique.notes: Map strengths, weaknesses, and conditions without collapsing the balance.

bayesian-hypothesis-network.notes: Use a concept map for hypothesis/evidence dependencies; preserve numeric probabilities only when stated in prose.

boundary-critique.notes: Map boundary judgments and the parties or purposes they serve.

coherence-audit.notes: Map inferential moves, warrants, and named tensions.

compositional-dynamics.notes: Annotate a supplied composition; use a concept map only for grounded verbal relationships.

conceptual-engineering.notes: Map current use, function failure, and proposed conceptual change.

decision-clarity.notes: Map decision criteria and dependencies without inventing scores.

differential-diagnosis.notes: Map candidate explanations and discriminating evidence.

domain-induction.notes: Map the source-grounded domain structure and open questions.

factual-lookup.notes: Use only when the answer contains grounded relationships; otherwise text remains canonical.

frame-audit.notes: Map the frame's assumptions, exclusions, and consequences.

frame-comparison.notes: Map competing frames and their points of divergence.

general-inquiry.notes: Use a visual when the answer contains source-grounded relationships.

interest-mapping.notes: Map parties to interests and their relationships.

ma-reading.notes: Map the source's material and interpretive relationships.

market-dynamics.notes: Use stated time values or source-grounded feedback relationships only.

mechanism-design.notes: Map incentives, mechanisms, and resulting behaviour.

mechanism-understanding.notes: Use a DAG for causal structure and a flowchart for procedural mechanism.

multi-criteria-decision.notes: Compare only criteria and values stated in the response.

place-reading-genius-loci.notes: Annotate a supplied place image; otherwise map grounded place relationships.

pre-mortem-action.notes: Map threat, preventive barrier, failure, and recovery relationships.

pre-mortem-fragility.notes: Map failure pathways and their grounded conditions.

principled-negotiation.notes: Map interests, options, and objective-criteria relationships without inventing positions.

probabilistic-forecasting.notes: Plot only stated forecasts, dates, ranges, and probabilities.

process-tracing.notes: Map evidence through the causal or procedural chain.

propaganda-audit.notes: Map claims, frames, audiences, and effects from the source.

quick-orientation.notes: Provide a small source-grounded orientation map when relationships help navigation.

simple.notes: Keep the visual optional and sparse; text remains canonical.

stakeholder-mapping.notes: Map parties, interests, power, and relationships without dropping marginal parties.

subjective-inquiry.notes: Map perspectives and criteria without implying an objective score.

third-side.notes: Map community rings, parties, and mediator roles.

wicked-future.notes: Map scenarios and divergence points using only stated probabilities or dates.

wicked-problems.notes: Map competing framings, stakeholders, and systemic dependencies.

worldview-cartography.notes: Map paradigms and tensions while preserving incommensurability.
